utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-87-A, the Prosecutor versus Nikola Sainovic, Nebojsa Pavkovic, Vladimir Lazarevic, and Sreten Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. May I please have the appearances of the parties. First, the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Sarah Finnin. I appear for the Prosecution with Barbara Goy and our case manager, Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. And now the Defence counsel, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Vladimir Petrovic on behalf of Mr. Nikola Sainovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. ALEKSIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Aleksander Aleksic for General Nebojsa Pavkovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom and around the courtroom. Mihajlo Bakrac, on behalf of Mr. Vladimir Lazarevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Co-counsel, Dan Ivetic, on behalf of Sreten Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. Before we start, can all the parties hear the proceedings in a language that they could understand? Mr. Sainovic? THE APPELLANT SAINOVIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you, very much. Mr. Lazarevic. THE APPELLANT LAZAREVIC: [Interpretation] I can understand, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Lukic. THE APPELLANT LUKIC: [Interpretation] I can follow, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. This Status Conference is called in accordance with the Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, which requires a Status Conference to be convened every 120 days during the appeals proceedings to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise any issues in relation thereto, including the mental and the physical condition of that person. In the present case, the last Status Conference was held on the 4th September, 2013. Today's Status Conference was scheduled by order issued on the 18th November, 2013. First, I would like to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and the health situation of the appellants. If you have any concern in relation to the detention conditions or your states of health that cannot be resolved through the standard procedures, I would invite you to raise them now. If you wish, this discussion can take place in private session. Yes, yes, Mr. Lazarevic. THE APPELLANT LAZAREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I won't be discussing my health and issues related to it or whatever is left of my health, to be more precise. Given the fact that this year-long struggle or the tau is nearing its end, I would like to thank you for the patience you have exhibited thus far as well as for your understanding and the assistance lent with regard to my health, as was the case at all of the previous Status Conferences. On occasion, following a Status Conference, certain competent authorities seemed to approach the issue of resolving my numerous health issues more readily. Thanks to you, Mr. President, Your Honour, I had the following opportunity. Since there wasn't much to boast in terms of my health, at least there was someone to turn to, to complain to - it was always you - and that is why I thank you yet again. That is all I wanted to say, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. Well, if there's no one to make a speech, I will turn to the next issue which is about recent procedural history. Before we turn to any issue that the parties may wish to raise, I would like to briefly mention one outstanding matter. On the 30th September, 2013, the Prosecution filed a request seeking leave to file certain portions of Charles Taylor's appeal judgement of the Special Court for Sierra Leone as supplementary authority in this case. The Prosecution submits that these portions contain the findings that are pertinent to its argument concerning the element of aiding and abetting liability. The Defence did not respond to this request. I note that the Appeals Chamber is aware of current relevant jurisprudence, including Taylor's appeal judgement. It is therefore unnecessary for the portions of Taylor's appeal judgement to be filed as a supplementary authority in this case. And the Prosecution's request is accordingly dismissed. At this point I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise. Is there any issue the Prosecution would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MS. FINNIN
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Sainovic, do you have any other issues you would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. PETROVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Lazarevic, do you have any issue to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. BAKRAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Lukic?

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: We have none, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Pavkovic? I'm sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. ALEKSIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing to raise, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Well, I think this concludes today's Status Conference. I thank the parties for their attention and adjourn these proceedings.
